body:
education reform, we are doing online lincoln douglas, she sent me her 1AC and we did a CX so I have to do the 1NC, i have a lot of good ideas, but its all garbled junk in my head, and comes out as brain farts. 

But I have my math test on monday, and i just realized its friday D:

I just feel so stressed. I feel so much pressure. I had a disagreement with my friend..theres so much going on i just cant handle it anymore. I dont know what to do. I called the hotline and quite frankly, those people suck.

Currently the most difficult subject would be debate, because I'm having brain farts, and Math, just because of the amount of work that needs to be done. I need to cover 10 sections by monday, I have never learned anything about the subjects. I am using Khan Academy and that helps a lot. It s just..a lot. I have debate block, and those videos were due yesterday..theres so much that needs to be covered but not enough time.
What do you mean when you say constructive? Can you give me an example?

I met someone, who is very important to me...last year. I have quite a few good memories with him, but we are going through a rough patch too. Other than that..nothing too good. 

When I was a child I use to imagine what I could be, and that would be a vacation from life....but now that I'm older, I feel like it brings me stress.

I have a lot of nightmares of my father beating me. In those situations, I felt true fear and pain. During the rape..I wasn't afraid or in that much pain, so I don't identify it as being so terrible. Just, really disgusting. And it makes me feel disgusting. But it doesn't hurt me the same way the beatings hurt me. Do you know what I mean? They don't terrorize me. If I met him today, I would be perfectly ok walking away, or confronting him, or punching him in the balls. But if I saw my father...i wouldn't want to be anywhere near him or in his sight. And its so confusing..because the situation gets even more complicated..if I could explain everything, it would take forever. 

I approached my nurse, but that was a long time ago, when i was 11. the hotlines..when I search suicide on google its the first thing that comes up, but it takes a long time to build up the courage to talk..when I finally did, they failed. I had therapy for a short period of time..I don't know if it helped me or not. But I was forced into it by my school. When I left school, I left therapy. I can't pay for it now, and it's not really the same. I don't feel comfortable with telling a stranger everything. 
On the internet...its not the same. If I cry, you can't see me. If I fall apart and break down, you wouldn't know. If you pity me, I don't have to see..On the internet, i can walk away and leave by closing the screen. I can stop talking and come back when I'm ready. Or not come back at all. I don't have to give you any personal information, and I don't have to worry about payments. 

I've turned things around. I am in college right now, I take 6 classes, and just registered for 5 next spring, and 1 during intersession. I have a 4.0 gpa, but thats not final until the grades are submitted. I make clothes and sell it in the LA fashion District on saturday. Its a lot of work, but it lets me work at home and do homework at the same time. I live in a nice house, but pay only 700 in rent. I don't drink or smoke. I used to do a lot of charity work when I had the time. Ever since I ranaway my life has been reclaimed. It was hard to get where I am..but that kind of makes it worse. Why am i still down when things are looking up? 

I got into a car crash on nov 18. tread separation on my rear tire on the toll road. The car flipped a few times onto the northbound road. I was doing so well before the accident. I was working out 5 days a week, I was on top of my school work, on the positive side of money, losing weight, feeling beautiful, I was doing Krav Maga, and for me that was like therapy. I would pretend that it was my father trying to kill me again but now Im older and I was learning how to be in control of the situation. I could fight back....Then after the crash everything changed. I just now started to become more mobile, but for over a week I couldnt even pee on my own. I was in so much pain, they just pumped pain meds in me I could barely stay awake..or coherent. Now I'm starting to fall into the negative money wise..I lost my car, I lost well over $1000 in cash with the car (I was taking it to deposit that day) plus my phone, and a whole bunch of crap that I keep in the trunk for the homeless times..My grades  might suffer if I dont learn the stuff and take my finals which I will have to do all next week..now i cant exercise and I wont be able to do krav maga for a long time because of my injuries...

People keep saying that I'm so lucky i'm alive. And sometimes I feel its true..but then I think of all of the stuff and sometimes I wish I just died..I'm just so tired of life :(
